issue.title: Split the gcal badges hash so private event notes reach rows with an edited title or time
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-ji.6 (note #2) as a planned follow-up of epic bob-cli-ji (private event notes, plan 202611/private_gcal_event_notes.md § Follow-ups); triaged by the bob-cli-ji land agent.

## Proposal
Split the single gcal row "badges" ownership hash in `src/native/gcal/plan.rs` into two spans: the Google link badges (📅/📹/📍) and the Bob-derived clock tag plus `[buffer::]`. Today a private event note changed after a row's birth reaches the buffer and clock tag only while the row's time, title, and badges are all untouched (documented as an accepted v1 cost in docs/gcal.md Known limits and in decisions:private-event-notes-beat-google-per-field "Cost"/"Reopens when"). With split hashes, a note edit would still update `[buffer::]`/`#off`/`#on` on a row whose title or time Bryan edited.

## Notes
- Journal compatibility: old `gcal.row` records carry the single hash; the new reader must treat them conservatively.
- Update docs/gcal-notes.md, docs/gcal.md Known limits, and record a new decision per the decisions web rules (the existing record is immutable).
